reviews.t: Lighter than expected. Almost a Nude/Lightpink versus a Pure Peach
reviews.x: The color was much lighter than advertised. I've included a photo of what I mean. The photo is of the product applied liberally, no gradient or wiping it off. This was the full color that I was able to achieve. I personally wanted something a bit more like the color in the advertised photo. Its a nice color, but it blends in with my skin tone way too much, so it ends up looking like a nude/pink color.  If that is the look you are looking for then its good or if you have a very pale/ivory complex

reviews.t: I like it!
reviews.x: The limited lip color selection and the reviews that many of the colors are similar or very bright were the only reasons I took months to make this purchase. I have no regrets finally buying this product!  I wanted a natural pink-peachy toned lip stain and this one fits the bill! I have sensitive lips that peel and crack easily. This makes it difficult for me to wear lipsticks (liquid, creamy, matte, etc,).  I really like this particular formula. It has a mousse-like texture when first applied (

reviews.t: A bit more orange than peach
reviews.x: Nice color and creamy feel. Goes on a bit splotchy with the sponge brush, but used lip brush or finger to even out color.  Does leave a bit of a 'stain' effect.  The pic shows after some blotting of the color.

reviews.t: Love.
reviews.x: Obsessed. Buying more colors after I write this. Goes on smooth and even smells peachy which I think is precious. Love it. Very creamy but still light and easy to work with.

reviews.t: Fun, Yummy, Cool!
reviews.x: I love it!  it tastes great.  It's soft and creamy.  I'm going to try other colors.  I wish it lasts longer but that's ok - theres plenty in the bottle!

reviews.t: It's a nice dupe for Benefit's Chacha tint
reviews.x: It's a nice dupe for Benefit's Chacha tint. I think the photo makes it appear darker than it actually is. It is much peachier in person. I think some people were saying how it stains a little if you don't rub it in right away? I have not experienced this problem. When using on lips, I have found that it is best only to swipe a little on the middle, and then smooth out the rest with your finger to achieve a gradient, natural look like the photo. Elsewise, it would get too peachy if you tried to a

reviews.t: Fun scent, lip color and tint in one
reviews.x: This basically has a built-in lip tint that will last *forever*.  If that's freaky to you, this is probably not the right product for you.  Note that the tint is not the same color as the lip color, and all the different colors end up leaving the same reddish coral tint.  I like the colors I got (Pure Peach, Beauty Peak Rose and Charming Coral) and I use them when I don't feel like reapplying color for the whole day/night and I don't mind if the color changes from the applied color to the tint l

reviews.t: Dollar store quality
reviews.x: I don't like this at all, I expected more of a stain and this is like a lip cream... it reminds me of this cheap lipgloss I used when I was a little lid.  The smell and everything reminds me of it. The color is also TOTALLY DIFFERENT than the swatch sample they show. It doesn't last longer than any other lipstick, and I wasn't impressed.  It seemed the same quality as a lip gloss I would get from the dollar store.

reviews.t: Don't waste your money on 012 Pure Peach
reviews.x: I was so excited to try this color out, I thought the formula would be very similar to one of the tints I have already. The formula is weird, it feels tacky and the color does not stay on at all! If I try to spread it on my lips the color mainly transfers to my fingertip and not my lips. The packaging of the tint itself looks like such low quality. The box it came in was all folded/creased. Compared to the lip tint packaging and formula I bought last time, this is a huge dissapointment.

reviews.t: This product is not great as a lip color
reviews.x: Okay so, first thing's first...This product is not great as a lip color. It's patchy, creamy yet emphasizes dry patches at the same time (???????), and is also not at all the nice color that is depicted on the model. It is, as other reviews have said, much more orange and also lighter. HOWEVER, what this product is good for is a cream blush. I stopped using it as a lip color and now dot it on my cheeks, and it gives a really nice glow so...score? I guess?

reviews.t: Not bad but kind of artificial and dry
reviews.x: This product is about as expected for the price, but I don’t use it very often for a few reasons. One, the color looks very artificial, kind of like a cotton candy color. It is also very drying on the lips, and does not last that long. A pro though is that the color is very pigmented- a little goes a long way. If the color was more my style (and maybe a strong, very light pink is yours!) then I might wear it more.

reviews.t: Nice lip tint
reviews.x: Love the color and it gives a very natural finish . You can't tell that I'm wearing something on my lips that's how natural it looks. I got the shade peach. Worth $8

reviews.t: I won’t recommend this!! The colors are misleading
reviews.x: I bought a shade of peach and it had no color at all. It felt like chalk finish and had a white tone to it. Nowhere close to what I ordered.

reviews.t: this was more like a 70's disco pink than an opaque peach
reviews.x: to get the right color, take the photo and lighten it about 3 shades. this was more like a 70's disco pink than an opaque peach.

reviews.t: Four Stars
reviews.x: I love the color, and it only needs to be minimally reapplied after eating.

reviews.t: One Star
reviews.x: Ew.. it wasn't look alike in the picture! Not stay long as well..

reviews.t: Very cute and light but color advertised can be misleading
reviews.x: I have quite a bit to say about this. I'll start out by saying that if you want a specific color, I HIGHLY recommend googling or going on YouTube to see a live version of the swatch being tested because I feel the advertising picture is a bit misleading. I ordered the Spring Orange and it was a lot more orange than I had expected. I thought it would be like a peachy pink orange. I still love it though even if it wasn't the color I want. The texture of it is very nice, it's "creamy" and d

reviews.t: Love. Go for it!
reviews.x: I bought this in Pure Peach. For those of us (including me) who initially thought this color was much lighter than pictured... it turns out that if you apply it generously and wear it like a lip gloss until it wears off naturally, you get a much darker and more vibrant stain which is comparable to the pics and lasts a long time. In the meantime, it wears like a gloss. The texture is great (very velvety) and I find it very moisturizing even though others have said it is drying. It has a faint but

reviews.t: (I'm red headed and fair skinned btw) The color was amazing. I don't like liquid lipsticks much because my ...
reviews.x: I got the color pure peach. (I'm red headed and fair skinned btw) The color was amazing. I don't like liquid lipsticks much because my lips are very dry and the color will crack. I would describe this product is a very hydrating sheer matte. The application isn't meant to be completely seamless which gives it a very natural but pigmented look. I apply one dot on the top lip and bottom and used my finger to apply to the rest of lip. It's also worth mentioning that pure peach looked exactly like t

reviews.t: Velvety and long lasting!
reviews.x: Feels soooo soft and velvety and smells great. It’s just a touch matte so it stays on the lips for a long time, but also doesn’t dry them or clump at all. It’s very similar to a tint. It’s like if a tint with some extra staying power. It’s very bright and can look kind of crazy with too much on. Add 4 dots to your lower lip with the wand, rub your lips together, and blend out the rest evenly with your finger. This product is great if you want that korean lip gradient and also if you want to comp

reviews.t: Don’t recommend the shade 12-pure peach
reviews.x: If you have pigmented lips, The shade pure peach is very patchy and streaky. It does not stain my lips in any way and accentuated my dryness. On me it looked very awkwardly light and bright. I don’t know if it’s just a bad batch or what. Because the formula feels the same as the other shades in this line, but the color just does not apply well. If you have pale lips then maybe this product may work for you, but this shade is light than my lips so it might not have achieved the results I see in p

reviews.t: I liked the formula a lot- it really is very creamy ...
reviews.x: I liked the formula a lot- it really is very creamy but still matte, which makes sense given its "velvet" name. The dropper on top of the bottle appears to be non-functional except unless I'm missing something; there's a regular doe-foot applicator on the underside of the cap. Unfortunately the Pure Peach color just looked strange on me (very fair + neutral/cool undertones), but I liked the formula enough that I'd consider trying other colors in the future.

reviews.t: pretty average
reviews.x: I'm in the middle with this one the color is pretty nice looking but the product is really patchy when you put it on you can see the streaks, it is also pretty thick. It applies a little better if mixed with it gloss it'll still have a streaky look but just keep working it, it'll even make the color look a lot more natural and less like you put paint on your lips. I might re buy the product just to see if it's any better then I remember

reviews.t: but I used a pinky coral lip velvet pencil from Nars under and used this on top and got a really pretty color! Super moi
reviews.x: The color is not as pigmented as the picture. Especially since I have darker lips, but I used a pinky coral lip velvet pencil from Nars under and used this on top and got a really pretty color! Super moist and smells good. You can layer on many layers to get a bit more pigmentation and blend but I took one star off because it didn't look like the picture. All in all I would buy again and it was delivered super fast! :)

reviews.t: At first it’s nice but then it makes ur lips looked cracked and chapped even wen it’s not
reviews.x: It’s not bad but it’s not the best I used to love this but I started noticing that wen it settled it made lines on ur lips and made it look sooo chapped at first it makes ur lips look cute and a soft moisturizing matte feeling at once but then if u have chapped lips it ends up exentuating it sum times my lips aren’t feeling chapped but it’ll make it looked chapped it gathers on dry spots or sumthin  😣🧐😒😤

claims.text: Many reviewers say the actual color is lighter or more orange than the advertised peach shade.
Reviewers frequently describe the formula as creamy and soft, with some finding it easy to work with.
Several reviewers note the product is patchy or splotchy and can emphasize dry patches.
Some reviewers praise the natural-looking finish and pleasant peachy scent.
A few reviewers complain that the color does not last long or transfers easily.
